card.name: Concentration figures before mg per mL
card.fires_on: Mostly the space or first digit right after "concentration of" or "volume of" in drug dilution text, just before a figure like 50 mg per mL. It also fires on a few small linking words such as "by" or "to" in other settings.

modes.label: Concentration number
modes.description: The gap or first digit of a strength figure after "concentration of" or "is" in reconstitution instructions.
modes.example: The concentration of each container is<< >>5 mg/mL.

modes.label: Linking word in a clause
modes.description: A short linking word after a past-tense or noun phrase, in prose or warning text.
modes.example: as previously described<< by>> us and others

modes.label: Decimal point in a range
modes.description: The decimal point inside a diluted strength range.

card.writes: It pushes toward odd code-like pieces and away from words like "secondary" and "producing", so there is no clear useful output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the spot just before a drug strength number such as 50 mg per mL in mixing instructions.
